title: Re: monthly bookkeeping is still manual (mirror)
text: Every month I still do this manually: I export the bank transactions from Xero to CSV, then copy and paste them into Excel because the client's CRM doesn't integrate with our accounting software. It takes me hours every week and re-keying the reference numbers is where mistakes creep in.
author: mirror_mo

title: Still re-keying client transactions
text: Every month I manually export the bank transactions from Xero to CSV and then re-key the client reference numbers into Excel because there is no integration with our accounting software. It takes me three hours every week and I hate it.
author: books_bella

title: Sage and Excel do not sync
text: As an accountant I still copy and paste the client transactions from Sage into Excel every week because the two systems do not sync. It is frustrating and takes me two hours each time.
author: ledger_lena

title: Manual invoice entry into practice system
text: Our accountant manually types the monthly client transactions from Xero into Excel because there is no integration with our accounting software. It takes me four hours every month and the copy and paste errors are painful.
author: fin_ops_owen
